items.author: Sarah Todd
items.body_excerpt: Seems timely to remind people (in light of Nurk having to miss time) that Jaxson Hayes was on video pushing and spitting at his partner with her yelling about not feeling safe and the NBA has seemingly not ever handed down any consequences. Feel bad for Jazz fans who will have to cheer for that.

items.title: I'm curious to see how the Jazz adapt with Jusuf Nurkic out to open the season. Jaren Jackson Jr. at the five, especially starting there, hasn't worked well, historically. Jaxson Hayes starts with Kyle Filipowski, Mo Bamba and small-ball behind him is probably the way Utah goes.
